SUPPORT AT HOME CARE PLAN — Capital Aged Care Services Pty Ltd

Provider: Capital Aged Care Services Pty Ltd
Participant: Robert Henderson
Classification: 5
Effective from: 01/01/2027
Effective to: 31/03/2027
Quarterly budget: $9,924.25
Pension status: part-pensioner

BUDGET SUMMARY
Care services base (excludes AT-HM): $9,000.00
Care management fee (10% of care services base): $900.00
AT-HM allocation (ring-fenced separately): $1,200.00
Rollover cap: $1,000.00

SERVICE CATEGORIES
Personal care: Clinical Care (0% participant contribution)
Domestic assistance: Everyday Living
Social support group: Independence

SERVICES DELIVERED
Personal care        Clinical Care       3 hr / week      $900.00
Social support group Independence        1 session / week $396.00
Nursing (wound care) Clinical Care       0.5 hr / week    $360.00

ASSESSED NEEDS
- Assistance with showering and dressing (personal care).
- Wound care management following a leg ulcer.
- Laundry assistance required weekly (participant cannot manage heavy loads).
- Wishes to stay connected socially, specifically the men's shed and lawn bowls.

GOALS
Goal 1: I want to keep showering safely on my own with a little help.
Goal 2: I want my leg ulcer to heal and stay healed.
Goal 3: I want clean clothes and bedding each week.
Goal 4: I want to get back to the men's shed and my Tuesday lawn bowls.

NARRATIVE
Robert is a 78 year old part-pensioner living alone. He was reclassified for
personal care from 01/10/2026 into Clinical Care. He is social and misses his
men's shed group and lawn bowls. He needs weekly laundry help.

CONSULTATION
This plan was developed in consultation with Robert and his daughter on 15/12/2026.
Review cadence: reviewed every 12 months or on changed needs.
